Challenge # B.

The manager of the wather treatment plant Dra. Olivia Waters, knows that the best drinkable and healthy water was achieved some days ago when she received a supply of 10 mg of Chlorine and 20 mg of Fluoride per liter of water. She used to also employ 30 mg of fluoride and 15 mg of chlorine per liter of water.
Find the ratio of Chlorine to Fluoride according to the supply information:

First scenario: Second scenario:

Fluoride (F): 20 mg/L Fluoride (F): 30 mg/L
